title: Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cloud Architect Especialista para atuar em um time estratégico de alta maturidade técnica, com foco em modernização de aplicações, infraestrutura em nuvem AWS e práticas avançadas de DevOps.

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;
  • Garantir conformidade das soluções com o AWS Well-Architected Framework;
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos técnicos e não técnicos, apoiando decisões estratégicas de arquitetura;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança, governança e observabilidade;
  • Promover compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria técnica e apoio à evolução do time.


Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de atuação comprovada em CTPS;
  • Experiência sólida e aprofundada com AWS;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS CDK (Python), AWS CloudFormation e Terraform;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de esteiras CI/CD, containers, Git, boas práticas DevOps e padrões de segurança;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica para interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Financeiro Pleno em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Analista Financeiro com perfil analítico e organizado para atuar na gestão de demandas de CAPEX e controle de contratações de terceiros. A posição terá foco na estruturação e padronização do processo de aprovações na ferramenta OneVerse, preparando o fluxo para futura automação.

  • Analisar e organizar SOWs (CAPEX);
  • Consolidar informações de diferentes fontes (principalmente e-mails);

  • Conduzir aprovações com stakeholders, incluindo nível executivo;
  • Gerenciar pipeline e garantir prazos e qualidade;
  • Identificar inconsistências e assegurar conformidade dos dados.


Requisitos:

  • Organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Inglês avançado (conversação);
  • Boa comunicação e proatividade.

title: Gestor(a) de Contas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gestor(a) de Contas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gestor(a) de Contas – Marketplace & Performance

Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces , com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance .

Buscamos um(a) Gestor(a) de Contas para atuar de forma estratégica, sendo responsável pela operação e pelos resultados dos clientes .

Essa posição exige visão analítica, senso de dono e capacidade de integrar estoque, tráfego, campanhas e performance comercial em diferentes marketplaces.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como responsável direto(a) pela performance dos clientes, sendo o ponto focal da conta
  • Monitorar e garantir SLA dos marketplaces, antecipando riscos e oportunidades
  • Acompanhar estoque no Centro de Distribuição e realizar solicitações de abastecimento para venda direta
  • Definir e acompanhar a estratégia de venda entre marketplaces (onde vender, quando e como)
  • Gerenciar campanhas ativas, mix de produtos e visibilidade nos marketplaces
  • Analisar dados de tráfego, estoque e conversão, propondo ações contínuas de crescimento
  • Atuar de forma próxima a clientes e lideranças, com comunicação clara, estratégica e orientada a resultados
  • Evoluir, em até 6 meses, para autonomia total na gestão da performance, regras de tráfego e decisões de estoque


Requisitos

  • Experiência com marketplaces e e-commerce, especialmente em gestão operacional e performance
  • Excel intermediário
  • Forte senso de dono, responsabilidade e visão de negócio
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com dados, indicadores e métricas
  • Afinidade com tecnologia e ferramentas digitais
  • Capacidade de navegação e análise em painéis de marketplace (ex.: Mercado Livre)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com clientes e lideranças


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com gestão de múltiplas contas ou operações simultâneas
  • Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado à melhoria contínua
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e com alta exigência por resultados


O que oferecemos

  • Salário compatível com o mercado
  • Remuneração variável trimestral , vinculada ao alcance de metas e resultados
  • Ambiente dinâmico, com autonomia e impacto direto no negócio


Modelo de trabalho

  • 100% remoto (Home Office)
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial no Centro de Distribuição no litoral de São Paulo , quando necessário.

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) .NET + Python + AWS


Modalidade: remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em .NET e Python, garantindo a eficiência e escalabilidade dos sistemas.

- Projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem utilizando AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS e outros.

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções técnicas eficazes.

- Participar na definição de arquiteturas de sistemas e na escolha de tecnologias apropriadas para os projetos.

- Implementar práticas de DevOps, incluindo CI/CD, automação de testes e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento e da qualidade do código.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações com .NET (C# ou VB.NET).

- Proficiência em Python e suas bibliotecas comuns.

- Conhecimento prático de serviços AWS e arquiteturas de nuvem.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, NoSQL).

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e excelentes habilidades de comunicação.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência em contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em práticas de segurança na nuvem.

title: Engenheiro de software
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de software em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Engenheiro de software


Descrição:


-Projetar, implementar e entregar funcionalidades complexas em componentes grandes ou aplicações de médio porte do design ao deploy;

-Experiência sólida com React/TypeScript no frontend, e Python/FastAPI no backend;

-Experiência com Azure Database, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, PostgreSQL e modelagem de dados relacional;

-Atuação com pgvector ou bancos vetoriais;

-Forte Domínio prático com Clean Code, SOLID, YAGNI, TDD, BDD e 12-Factor App;

-Experiência com Microsoft Azure, GitHub Actions, Claude Code e práticas de CI/CD;

-Experiência com Segurança e governança: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault e Microsoft Purview;

-Proficiência em uma ampla gama de design patterns e estruturas de dados;

-Experiência com observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing);

- Escrever código limpo, seguro, estável e testável que qualquer engenheiro do time consiga entender e resolver problemas técnicos difíceis com soluções pragmáticas;

-Testar código com rigor: testes unitários, de integração e de contrato (não são etapas separadas);

- Documentar o software com clareza: decisões arquiteturais, intenções de design e contratos entre componentes;


Diferencial:

-Conhecimento em integração de APIs de IA (Claude API, OpenAI) e construção de features com LLMs;

-Familiaridade com Azure API Management, Azure Event Grid ou event-driven architecture;

-Experiência com compliance (LGPD);

-Vivência em ambientes de alto crescimento ou startups com times enxutos e alta cadência de entrega;

-Contribuições em projetos open source ou portfólio técnico público;


Atuação Home Office

Contratação CLT


O que oferecemos?

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

WellHub;

Seguro de Vida;



Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Salesforce em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

✅ *DESENVOLVEDOR SALESFORCE COM VLOCITY SÊNIOR – *

O profissional atuará com desenvolvimento avançado e arquitetura Salesforce, com forte foco no setor de Energy & Utilities. O papel envolve a tradução de requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis, mapeamento e otimização de processos da indústria, avaliação de arquiteturas corporativas e a condução independente de reuniões técnicas com clientes.

Experiência prática nas seguintes áreas (Todas as habilidades abaixo são obrigatórias):

• Experiência de nível sênior comprovada em desenvolvimento Salesforce.

• Forte atuação em Salesforce Industries (Vlocity), incluindo OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, DataRaptors e FlexCards.

• Experiência em soluções para o setor de Energy & Utilities, compreendendo modelos de dados e processos regulatórios.

• Domínio prático de APEX, LWC, Visualforce, Aura Components e Salesforce DX.

• Experiência avançada em versionamento de código e gestão de configurações (Git, DevOps Center ou similares).

• Forte entendimento do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) e práticas modernas de engenharia (CI/CD, testes unitários, design patterns).

• Visão estratégica para avaliar arquiteturas corporativas, integrações e tendências da indústria.

• Fortes soft skills: excelente comunicação, resolução de problemas orientada a impacto, gestão de tempo, resiliência e competência para atuação em times remotos.

Prazo: dez2026 (com grandes possibilidades de prorrogação)

Remoto

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: Director of Data Analytics
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Director of Data Analytics em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Opportunity

The Director of Data Analytics will lead the data strategy, data science and analytics functions for the company, driving decisions involving the integration and management of data as well as delivering business insights through data analytics, dashboard development and predictive models. This Director will contribute at a strategic level and will steer our strategy with their insights. This role manages a full-time data analyst and supports key stakeholders in Marketing, Sales, Product, and Engineering to better understand the metrics, trends and insights behind the business. This role reports to the Chief Financial Officer.


Your Impact

  • Own our data strategy. Lead the planning, prioritization and deployment of all data initiatives for the company, including dashboard development, ad hoc analysis and predictive analytics projects. This includes driving the vision of AI use within data
  • Drive analytics and insights by being a thought leader and authority for the company on trends of key business metrics (ie. LTV, CAC, ARR, ARPA, Churn, and AOV).
  • Maintain and establish analytical frameworks to support product, business and operational decision making.
  • Manage dashboards, reports, and visualizations using our data warehouse (Snowflake), transformation layer (DBT) and visualization solution (Looker)
  • Collaborate and provide thought leadership across departments (Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales and Finance) to understand and support ongoing and new data requirements, driving data development projects and improvements
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of conversion rates in purchase funnels and subscriber churn, providing strategic recommendations for optimization.
  • Develop predictive models to identify trends or make connections between disparate data sources that yield insights to drive more informed decision making
  • Ensure data quality and governance: Build and maintain systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across the organization.


What You Bring

  • 7+ years experience in data management role in a subscription/SaaS business
  • Proven experience in business intelligence, with a strong background in data analysis and visualization
  • Leadership experience with the ability to manage and grow a BI-focused team
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with data warehousing and visualization technologies like Snowflake, Looker, DBT
  • Understanding of key business metrics and their impact on subscription and transactional models
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into actionable business strategies
  • Experience in data science and predictive analytics
  • Statistical background including model building experience a significant plus

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Social Media Coordinator to join our global team on a six-month contract, with the potential to extend. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who already knows social media.


You will work closely with their Senior Specialists and Senior Manager, taking ownership of mid-tier campaign coordination, skilled content support, and reporting and analytics. Strong English writing skills and a confident grasp of LinkedIn content are essential — as is the ability to exercise content judgement independently.


You will be able to confidently use AI to support efficiency but have good judgment and attention to detail to ensure outputs are accurate and effective.


Please note: This is a contract role through the end of the year (December 31).


Key Responsibilities:

Skilled Content Support

  • Select assets for posts across mid-tier campaigns, applying content judgment and brand standards
  • Write captions for quick-turn posts and one-off content requests, in line with brand tone and best practices
  • Ensure posts align with brand guidelines before publishing
  • Support with Elevate (employee advocacy platform) requests, including self-serve rollout


Campaign Coordination

  • Own coordination of campaigns end-to-end
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to manage timelines, approvals, and content plans
  • Manage campaign tracking and visibility for assigned workstreams


Reporting and Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data collection frameworks for monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
  • Produce campaign reports


Publishing and Content Calendar

  • Upload and schedule some content in Sprinklr, ensuring correct tagging and visibility


What We're Looking For:

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of social media experience, with a strong LinkedIn track record — social content creation experience is essential
  • Excellent written English — you can write clean, on-brand captions and coordinate across multiple stakeholders without heavy oversight
  • Strong content judgement — you can select assets and write for social independently, and know what good looks like on LinkedIn
  • Proven experience managing content calendars and coordinating with multiple teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with reporting: you can pull data, build dashboards, and present findings clearly
  • Experience with social media publishing tools (Sprinklr or similar)
  • Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities with minimal direction


Preferred

  • Experience coordinating social media for a B2B, professional services, or large corporate brand
  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms
  • Experience producing or supporting reporting outputs for senior stakeholders
  • Proficiency with MS Office and digital collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
  • What to Expect
  • This is a high-output, fast-paced role. You will be working across multiple campaigns simultaneously, with stakeholders in different time zones. You will have clear ownership of your workstreams and work within the wider Social Media team.
  • This is not a role for someone learning the basics of social media. It is an opportunity for an experienced social media professional to make an immediate impact, deliver quality work, and develop deeper expertise within a high-performing global team.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful LinkedIn and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the correct L2 teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field.
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in technical customer support.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Possess an attention to detail.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Basic understanding of frameworks such as Agile, ITIL, COBIT.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Coordinator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Social Media Coordinator to join our global team on a six-month contract, with the potential to extend. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who already knows social media.


You will work closely with their Senior Specialists and Senior Manager, taking ownership of mid-tier campaign coordination, skilled content support, and reporting and analytics. Strong English writing skills and a confident grasp of LinkedIn content are essential — as is the ability to exercise content judgement independently.


You will be able to confidently use AI to support efficiency but have good judgment and attention to detail to ensure outputs are accurate and effective.


Please note: This is a contract role through the end of the year (December 31).


Key Responsibilities:

Skilled Content Support

  • Select assets for posts across mid-tier campaigns, applying content judgment and brand standards
  • Write captions for quick-turn posts and one-off content requests, in line with brand tone and best practices
  • Ensure posts align with brand guidelines before publishing
  • Support with Elevate (employee advocacy platform) requests, including self-serve rollout


Campaign Coordination

  • Own coordination of campaigns end-to-end
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to manage timelines, approvals, and content plans
  • Manage campaign tracking and visibility for assigned workstreams


Reporting and Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data collection frameworks for monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
  • Produce campaign reports


Publishing and Content Calendar

  • Upload and schedule some content in Sprinklr, ensuring correct tagging and visibility


What We're Looking For:

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of social media experience, with a strong LinkedIn track record — social content creation experience is essential
  • Excellent written English — you can write clean, on-brand captions and coordinate across multiple stakeholders without heavy oversight
  • Strong content judgement — you can select assets and write for social independently, and know what good looks like on LinkedIn
  • Proven experience managing content calendars and coordinating with multiple teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with reporting: you can pull data, build dashboards, and present findings clearly
  • Experience with social media publishing tools (Sprinklr or similar)
  • Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities with minimal direction


Preferred

  • Experience coordinating social media for a B2B, professional services, or large corporate brand
  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms
  • Experience producing or supporting reporting outputs for senior stakeholders
  • Proficiency with MS Office and digital collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
  • What to Expect
  • This is a high-output, fast-paced role. You will be working across multiple campaigns simultaneously, with stakeholders in different time zones. You will have clear ownership of your workstreams and work within the wider Social Media team.
  • This is not a role for someone learning the basics of social media. It is an opportunity for an experienced social media professional to make an immediate impact, deliver quality work, and develop deeper expertise within a high-performing global team.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful LinkedIn and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Analista de Governança PL – SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Governança PL – SAP em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos por um(a) Data Migration Governance Analyst – SAP S/4HANA, para atuar de forma remota em um programa global de transformação SAP S/4HANA, sendo responsável por garantir a governança, rastreabilidade, conformidade e qualidade do processo de migração de dados.

Essa posição terá forte atuação na revisão de evidências, validação documental, conformidade de processos e acompanhamento das etapas de migração de dados em ambiente corporativo global, atuando em conjunto com times técnicos, Data Owners, PMO, Governança e stakeholders internacionais.


RESPONSABILIDADES:

• Revisar criticamente documentações e evidências de migração de dados (dados mestres e transacionais), garantindo aderência aos padrões definidos pelo programa;

• Validar etapas obrigatórias do processo de migração, como extração, pré-load, load, reconciliação e validação pós-load;

• Garantir conformidade com templates, checklists, políticas e processos de governança;

• Avaliar qualidade e rastreabilidade das evidências sob a ótica de auditoria interna e externa;

• Identificar gaps, inconsistências, riscos e pontos de não conformidade;

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas, governança, PMO e Data Owners;

• Acompanhar pendências, aprovações e status por país, release e objeto migrado;

• Garantir organização e rastreabilidade das informações em ferramentas como Azure DevOps e SharePoint;

• Apoiar a preparação de pacotes de evidências para auditoria;

• Contribuir com melhorias contínuas em processos, templates, controles e governança.


HABILIDADES E EXPERIÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS:

• Experiência com governança, auditoria, compliance, controles internos ou conformidade em ambientes corporativos;

• Conhecimento em Lei Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX);

• Conhecimento em metodologia COSO;

• Experiência com análise documental, rastreabilidade e validação de evidências;

• Vivência em projetos de transformação, ERP, migração de dados ou governança de dados;

• Experiência prévia com SAP, especialmente em contextos relacionados à migração, Master Data, governança ou SAP MDG;

• Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação em ambiente global;

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de interação com múltiplos stakeholders;

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Evaluation Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Social Media Coordinator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Social Media Coordinator to join our global team on a six-month contract, with the potential to extend. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who already knows social media.


You will work closely with their Senior Specialists and Senior Manager, taking ownership of mid-tier campaign coordination, skilled content support, and reporting and analytics. Strong English writing skills and a confident grasp of LinkedIn content are essential — as is the ability to exercise content judgement independently.


You will be able to confidently use AI to support efficiency but have good judgment and attention to detail to ensure outputs are accurate and effective.


Please note: This is a contract role through the end of the year (December 31).


Key Responsibilities:

Skilled Content Support

  • Select assets for posts across mid-tier campaigns, applying content judgment and brand standards
  • Write captions for quick-turn posts and one-off content requests, in line with brand tone and best practices
  • Ensure posts align with brand guidelines before publishing
  • Support with Elevate (employee advocacy platform) requests, including self-serve rollout


Campaign Coordination

  • Own coordination of campaigns end-to-end
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to manage timelines, approvals, and content plans
  • Manage campaign tracking and visibility for assigned workstreams


Reporting and Analytics

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data collection frameworks for monthly, quarterly, and annual reports
  • Produce campaign reports


Publishing and Content Calendar

  • Upload and schedule some content in Sprinklr, ensuring correct tagging and visibility


What We're Looking For:

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of social media experience, with a strong LinkedIn track record — social content creation experience is essential
  • Excellent written English — you can write clean, on-brand captions and coordinate across multiple stakeholders without heavy oversight
  • Strong content judgement — you can select assets and write for social independently, and know what good looks like on LinkedIn
  • Proven experience managing content calendars and coordinating with multiple teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with reporting: you can pull data, build dashboards, and present findings clearly
  • Experience with social media publishing tools (Sprinklr or similar)
  • Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities with minimal direction


Preferred

  • Experience coordinating social media for a B2B, professional services, or large corporate brand
  • Familiarity with employee advocacy platforms
  • Experience producing or supporting reporting outputs for senior stakeholders
  • Proficiency with MS Office and digital collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
  • What to Expect
  • This is a high-output, fast-paced role. You will be working across multiple campaigns simultaneously, with stakeholders in different time zones. You will have clear ownership of your workstreams and work within the wider Social Media team.
  • This is not a role for someone learning the basics of social media. It is an opportunity for an experienced social media professional to make an immediate impact, deliver quality work, and develop deeper expertise within a high-performing global team.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful LinkedIn and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Maintenance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Maintenance Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Morgan Latif is an executive search and development consultancy focused on outcome-driven leadership hiring.


We partner with organisations across Medical Technology & Healthcare, Packaging, Chemicals & Speciality Materials, Consumer, and Industrial Technology to secure leaders who create measurable impact and long-term business performance.


Through deep sector expertise, rigorous assessment, and alignment to business objectives, we identify individuals who not only fit the role, but perform strongly and thrive within the organisation.


Job Title: Maintenance Manager

Company: Multi-national Mood Manufacturer


Position is based in Valencia, Spain and relocation would be supported should your application be successful.


We are working with a fast paced, Private-Equity backed, Food Manufacturing business who is seeking someone with a strong drive for process optimization , CMMS implementation , and leading a maintenance team of approximately 20 people .


The role will involve leading and coordinating maintenance activities for a 24/7 continuous-process plant , managing and optimizing maintenance for process equipment, and driving the transition from reactive to proactive, reliability-based maintenance , including preventative and predictive strategies.


Fluency in both English and Spanish is essential for this role.


Candidate Profile:

  • Fluent English & Spanish speaker
  • Strong experience in process industries (mandatory), such as food, or paper manufacturing.
  • Proven background in reliability-focused maintenance within environments where maintenance strategies are already mature.
  • Ability to implement and sustain best practices in preventive and predictive maintenance.
  • High level of safety awareness, especially in energy-intensive and high-risk environments.
  • High level of Quality awareness linked with Food industry
  • Strong leadership and soft skills to drive cultural change and build trust and accountability.
  • Experience managing complex maintenance organizations and driving data-driven decision-making.
  • Comfortable working with new equipment and establishing KPIs (e.g., MTBF still to be defined due to new machinery).


KPI:

  • Asset reliability / up time (OEE improvement)
  • Reduction of unplanned downtime
  • Preventive vs reactive maintenance ratio
  • Safety, food safety & compliance
  • Maintenance cost vs downtime cost optimization


If you feel up to for a challenge and thrive in a dynamic environment, we look forward to receiving your application!

description:

Monthly salary: $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Social Media Coordinator to join our global team on a six-month contract, with the potential to extend. This is a hands-on execution role for someone who already knows social media.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Produce campaign reports


Publishing and Content Calendar

What We're Looking For:

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years of social media experience, with a strong LinkedIn track record — social content creation experience is essential
  • Excellent written English — you can write clean, on-brand captions and coordinate across multiple stakeholders without heavy oversight
  • Strong content judgement — you can select assets and write for social independently, and know what good looks like on LinkedIn
  • Proven experience managing content calendars and coordinating with multiple teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with reporting: you can pull data, build dashboards, and present findings clearly
  • Experience with social media publishing tools (Sprinklr or similar)
  • Highly organised and able to manage competing priorities with minimal direction


Preferred

  • Experience coordinating social media for a B2B, professional services, or large corporate brand

  • Experience producing or supporting reporting outputs for senior stakeholders
  • Proficiency with MS Office and digital collaboration tools (Teams, Zoom)

  • This is a high-output, fast-paced role. You will be working across multiple campaigns simultaneously, with stakeholders in different time zones. You will have clear ownership of your workstreams and work within the wider Social Media team.
  • This is not a role for someone learning the basics of social media. It is an opportunity for an experienced social media professional to make an immediate impact, deliver quality work, and develop deeper expertise within a high-performing global team.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful LinkedIn and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.

title: Business Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Operations Sr Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.

  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions

  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – client uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases

  • Advanced English required



Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedores ABAP para integrar o time de um de nossos principais clientes: uma multinacional líder mundial no desenvolvimento de software de gestão empresarial, reconhecida pelo seu laboratório de inovação e alta tecnologia.

A posição combina atividades de sustentação (AMS), troubleshooting avançado e desenvolvimento evolutivo, exigindo profundidade técnica e capacidade de atuar em cenários complexos, muitas vezes com baixa documentação.


Atribuições principais:

  • Atuar na sustentação e manutenção evolutiva de aplicações SAP, garantindo estabilidade e performance das soluções
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado (debugging, análise de dumps, correção de incidentes)
  • Desenvolver e ajustar funcionalidades utilizando ABAP (procedural e orientado a objetos)
  • Criar e manter CDS Views, serviços OData e integrações com aplicações Fiori
  • Trabalhar com RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model) em cenários modernos
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento (Clean ABAP)
  • Atuar de forma proativa na identificação de problemas e melhorias
  • Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores menos experientes
  • Interagir com times globais em inglês (discussões técnicas, alinhamentos e troubleshooting)


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com ABAP clássico e orientado a objetos
  • Vivência em ambiente SAP S/4HANA
  • Experiência prática com: CDS Views RAP Serviços OData
  • Experiência com debugging e troubleshooting em ambientes produtivos
  • Conhecimento em processos de negócio, especialmente: SD (Sales and Distribution) e/ou MM (Materials Management)
  • Experiência com ADT (ABAP Development Tools) no Eclipse
  • Inglês avançado para conversação (interação diária com times globais)


Requisitos Comportamentais:

  • Proatividade e senso de dono
  • Organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de atuar com autonomia em cenários complexos


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP BTP (ABAP Environment)
  • Exposição a cenários de integração com IA
  • Vivência prévia em ambientes globais ou times distribuídos

100% remota


Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.


Quais são nossos valores?

- Somos pessoas servindo pessoas

- Pensamos e agimos como donos

- Temos gana por performance

- Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

- Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade

- Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Warehouse Automation Specialist (Senior)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Warehouse Automation Specialist (Senior) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um estudante para atuar como Estagiário(a) de Direito para se juntar à nossa equipe em Salvador-BA (Brasil), para atuar em nosso Departamento Jurídico, sob supervisão direta da Diretoria Jurídica.   • Bolsa-auxílio: R$ 1.850,00.

title: Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer (Snowflake) - Relocation to Portugal em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto.
