title: Founding Operator / Head of Sales (com mandato de virar CEO)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Founding Operator / Head of Sales (com mandato de virar CEO) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A VAGA


A Hamurabi Apps está contratando uma pessoa vendedora, operadora, intensa e extremamente dona pra fundar e liderar nosso estúdio de micro-apps.


A vaga tem um arco claro. Nos primeiros 3-6 meses, você é, na prática, Head of Sales: prospecção, demo, proposta, fechamento, expansão. Sem SDR, sem closer, você. Conforme a receita aparece e o time cresce, o escopo se abre pra operação completa: time, parcerias, portfólio, governança e, eventualmente, o cargo de CEO.


Vaga founding, equity-only. Você trabalha direto com o Pablo (founder da Izzicupo Borges, que adquiriu a Hamurabi) e com o Founding CTO, que vamos trazer em paralelo.


SNAPSHOT


• Localização: Remoto Brasil + workshops/sprints ocasionais em Uberlândia/MG (sede da Izzicupo Borges)

• Modelo: equity-only no início, com gatilhos claros de receita destravando comp fixa + variável (detalhe em POTENCIAL DE GANHO)

• Equity: 20% founding-level (vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano, reverse vesting, bad leaver clauses padrão)

• Variável: 5% sobre nova receita líquida que você fechar pessoalmente, durante toda a fase pré-CEO

• Path to CEO: mandato real ao atingir MRR R$ 100k/mês com NRR > 90%

• Perfil: operador-vendedor full-cycle, builder, customer-obsessed, confortável vendendo pra dev, advogado, dono de SMB e ops manager no mesmo mês


O QUE FAZEMOS


A Hamurabi Apps é um estúdio de micro-apps. Nascemos como software house low-code/no-code (Bubble Silver Partner). Em 2025, fomos adquiridos pela Izzicupo Borges e estamos relançando a tese: portfólio focado de produtos com receita recorrente, todos construídos, operados e licenciados sob o mesmo teto, com infra compartilhada e distribuição cruzada. Cinco micro-apps medianos rendendo R$ 30k de MRR cada batem uma startup média lutando por PMF.


Portfólio atual (5 produtos não lançados publicamente):

• Análise de risco jurídico em contratos com NLP, pra escritórios e jurídicos in-house

• Analytics de performance de engenharia com IA, pra times técnicos e CTOs

• Plataforma de automação e infra cloud, pra times que orquestram deploy e workflows

• ERPs sob medida pra PMEs (gestão financeira, fiscal, operacional)

• Agente que constrói landing pages do zero a partir de prompt


NOSSA MISSÃO


Provar que dá pra construir uma fábrica brasileira de software AI-native gerando milhões em ARR com time pequeno, intenso e dono. A maioria dos estúdios brasileiros nasce com cara de incubadora, escritório bonito, demo day e zero produto rodando. A Hamurabi nasce do oposto: produto primeiro, narrativa depois.


COMO É O DIA A DIA


Você não vai herdar uma operação rodando, vai construí-la. Não tem CFO, RH, SDR, CS ou marketing. Tem o Pablo, o Founding CTO (que vamos trazer em paralelo), 1 dev pleno e os 5 produtos no portfólio.


A pessoa certa consegue ouvir um dev reclamando do produto de analytics às 9h, fechar contrato do produto jurídico com diretor de jurídico ao meio-dia, ajustar pricing do produto de cloud à tarde, escrever JD pro próximo founding builder à noite, e no dia seguinte abrir um doc de tese pra novo micro-app.


NÃO APLIQUE SE VOCÊ:


• Espera receber estrutura pronta. Aqui não tem. Você É a estrutura

• Precisa de salário fixo grande. A base é zero no início. Dinheiro vem da equity, dos gatilhos e do variável

• Não consegue vender produto de software pra cliente diferente cada semana (advogado, dev, dono de PME, ops manager)

• Tem ego de cargo. Você vai fazer SDR, CS, marketing, copy, RH, planejamento, tudo, sozinho, no começo

• Não usa IA pra acelerar pesquisa, vendas, copy, automação, qualificação e operação

• Precisa de processo todo desenhado e meta toda calculada antes de começar

• Não topa ambiente de altíssima exigência. Acompanhamos receita, retenção e atividade semanalmente desde o dia 1. Quem não produz não permanece


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER


Vender (responsabilidade #1, sobretudo nos primeiros 3-6 meses):

• Vender pessoalmente até a Hamurabi atingir MRR R$ 100k/mês. Sem SDR, sem closer, você

• Construir e operar a esteira de prospecção (cold call, cold email, , eventos, indicações, ABM, partnerships)

• Conduzir o ciclo inteiro: discovery, demo, proposta, negociação, fechamento, handoff

• Estruturar expansão dentro de cliente existente e ativar parcerias de distribuição


Operar o portfólio (escopo cresce a partir do mês 6):

• Avaliar maturidade, fit de mercado e potencial de receita de cada produto

• Definir a aposta principal dos próximos 6 meses, pricing, posicionamento, ICP e GTM por produto

• Manter dashboard de portfolio com MRR, churn, CAC, LTV, NPS e burn por produto

• Decidir quando dobrar, quando matar, quando licenciar, quando desinvestir


Construir time, playbook e operar com Pablo + CTO:

• Contratar a guilda de founding builders na medida em que a receita destrava

• Formar e mentorar os juniors que já estão no radar (recém-formados que entram com fome)

• Documentar como a Hamurabi avalia, lança, opera, escala e desativa um micro-app

• Trabalhar lado a lado com o Pablo na visão estratégica e com o CTO na execução técnica

• Reportar progresso semanalmente com honestidade radical. Ao atingir MRR R$ 100k/mês com NRR > 90%, assumir formalmente o cargo de CEO


FERRAMENTAS


WhatsApp · ClickUp ou Notion · Google Workspace · Cursor, Claude e ChatGPT pra prospecção, research, copy, automação e agentes · Stripe pra billing · GitHub, Vercel, Railway, AWS pra infra. Loom, Apollo, Sales Navigator a gente provê quando precisar. Regra: pouca ferramenta, muita execução, IA fazendo o trabalho pesado.


QUALIFICAÇÕES MÍNIMAS


• Experiência real construindo ou operando produto/operação de software B2B em ciclo completo (founder, founding employee, head of growth/product, COO de startup ou consultor que operou clientes)

• Ter operado venda B2B de software com decisor de verdade (dev lead, diretor jurídico, dono de PME, ops manager, head of engineering)

• Capacidade de escrever bem: cold email, copy, proposta, doc interno, JD

• Uso intenso de IA pra prospectar, pesquisar, escrever, qualificar, automatizar e operar

• Tolerância a risco real: você topa equity-only no início em troca de equity founding-level e path to CEO

• Capacidade de fazer hands-on E pensamento estratégico no mesmo dia, sem confundir os dois


DIFERENCIAIS


• Já ter sido founding employee #1, #2 ou #3 de uma startup que atingiu PMF e escalou

• Já ter operado portfolio (multi-produto, multi-cliente) em estúdio, agência ou holding

• Já ter levado uma operação comercial de R$ 0 a 7 figures de ARR

• Já ter contratado, formado e liderado time de 5 a 15 pessoas

• Background técnico ou facilidade absoluta de conversar com engenheiro sem traduzir

• Vontade real de virar CEO, com o que isso significa: visão, board, captação, contratação, demissão, cultura


COMO MEDIMOS SUCESSO


Indicadores mudam ao longo da rampa. Diagnóstico, depois MRR, depois retenção, depois expansão.

• Diagnóstico (semanas 1-4): doc de avaliação dos 5 produtos com prioridade clara, ICP por produto, copy renovado, pricing validado

• Receita inicial (mês 2-3): primeiros R$ 5k a R$ 10k de MRR novo, vendido por você

• MRR (mês 4+): trajetória clara rumo a R$ 30k, R$ 80k, R$ 200k

• Retenção: NRR > 100%, churn mensal < 5%

• Ownership: você define meta, executa, comunica risco cedo, entrega sem precisar ser microgerenciado


CULTURA HAMURABI


Não confundimos flexibilidade com baixa intensidade. Não confundimos remoto com folga. Usamos muito IA, mas também esperamos que você saiba o que está acontecendo por baixo: cliente, dor real, produto, número, contrato, relacionamento. A gente não tem fôlego pra carregar quem não está produzindo. Quem performa tem autonomia total, equity founding-level e path real pra virar CEO.


Ownership extremo • Honestidade radical • Entrega acima de discurso • Velocidade com qualidade • Customer love acima de tudo • Multi-produto, multi-cliente, multi-chapéu • IA como alavanca diária


E principalmente:

• TODO MUNDO DONO (sim, todos os re-founding members terão equity)


POTENCIAL DE GANHO


Compensação inicial é equity-only de propósito. O upside é o ponto inteiro dessa vaga.


Equity: 20% founding-level, vesting 4 anos, cliff 1 ano. Em tese realizada (R$ 5M+ de ARR, múltiplos SaaS B2B 5-10x), pode atingir R$ 5M-10M. Em tese acelerada (R$ 15M+ de ARR), R$ 15M-30M.


Compensation destravada por receita:

• MRR R$ 30k/mês: base R$ 8k/mês PJ (~R$ 96k/ano)

• MRR R$ 80k/mês: base R$ 15k/mês (R$ 180k/ano)

• MRR R$ 200k/mês: base R$ 25k/mês + variável definida


Variável pré-CEO: 5% sobre nova receita líquida que você fechar. R$ 1M de novo ARR = R$ 50k. R$ 3M = R$ 150k.


Path to CEO: ao atingir MRR R$ 100k/mês com NRR > 90%, você assume formalmente. Comp evolui pra padrão CEO early-stage.


COMO APLICAR


Lemos toda aplicação séria e damos retorno.


E-mail:

• Para:

• Assunto: Founding Operator - Hamurabi - Aplicacao

• ou currículo + texto curto se apresentando


Responda também:

• Por que você quer operar a Hamurabi no modelo micro-apps studio?

• Qual a operação ou produto mais difícil que você já tirou do papel? Tese, execução, resultado

• Maior contrato B2B de software que você fechou pessoalmente? Ticket, ciclo, decisor, como ganhou?

• Olhando os 5 produtos descritos acima, qual você apostaria como aposta principal pros próximos 6 meses, e por quê?

• Como você usaria IA hoje pra acelerar a operação inteira do estúdio?

• Você topa equity-only no início, com gatilhos de receita destravando comp e mandato real de virar CEO?

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate


Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

description:

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles.
  • Bachelor’s or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth
  • Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design.
  • Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work.
  • Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation.
  • Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work.
  • Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Must be fluent in English , with additional languages being a plus.


**Please submit your CV in English.


Our Values:

  • A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability
  • B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial
  • C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness
  • D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly
  • E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you’re passionate about making an impact, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Gerente de finanças
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de finanças em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

GERENTE FINANCEIRO — ESTRATÉGIA E OPERAÇÕES

Buscamos um Gerente Financeiro com visão estratégica e perfil analítico para liderar nossa

estrutura de capital. Este profissional não será apenas um executor de processos, mas

um parceiro de negócios fundamental para a tomada de decisão. O desafio envolve

gerenciar a complexidade financeira de múltiplos lançamentos simultâneos, garantindo

que a liquidez e a rentabilidade caminhem juntas em um modelo de trabalho híbrido, que

valoriza a autonomia e a entrega de resultados.


Responsabilidades Principais

O candidato selecionado terá sob sua responsabilidade as seguintes atribuições:

-Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa:  Monitoramento rigoroso das entradas e saídas, com projeções de curto e longo

prazo para suportar o ciclo de vida dos lançamentos.

-Análise de Rentabilidade e ROI:  Avaliação detalhada da performance financeira de cada projeto,

identificando gargalos e oportunidades de otimização de margem.

-Gestão de Custos e Despesas:  Controle de orçamentos operacionais, gestão de fornecedores e otimização

da estrutura de custos fixos e variáveis.

-Estratégia de Captação e Investimento:  Elaboração de planos para alocação eficiente de capital e interface

com instituições para estruturação de crédito ou investimentos.

-Reporting Gerencial:  Elaboração de DREs, balancetes e dashboards financeiros para apresentação direta à

diretoria e investidores.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Para esta posição, é fundamental que o profissional apresente:

-Formação Acadêmica:  Graduação completa em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração de Empresas ou

áreas correlatas.

-Experiência Profissional:  Sólida trajetória comprovada em gestão financeira, preferencialmente em cargos

de liderança ou coordenação sênior.

-Competências Técnicas:  Domínio avançado de Excel/Google Sheets, ferramentas de ERP financeiro e

análise de indicadores (KPIs) financeiros.

-Perfil Comportamental:  Resiliência para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos, excelente capacidade de

comunicação e foco absoluto em eficiência.


Diferenciais

Serão considerados pontos de destaque no processo seletivo:

-Experiência prévia em startups , empresas de tecnologia ou agências de lançamentos digitais .

-Conhecimento em tributação para o mercado de infoprodutos e plataformas de pagamento (Hotmart, Eduzz,

Kiwify, etc.).

-Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Financeira, Controladoria ou Auditoria.

Inglês avançado para interface com parceiros internacionais.


6. O Que OferecemosProporcionamos um ambiente de trabalho que estimula a inovação e o crescimento

contínuo. O profissional terá a oportunidade de estruturar processos financeiros em uma

empresa que dobra de tamanho anualmente, contando com autonomia para implementar

melhorias e ferramentas que otimizem a operação.


Remuneração

Remuneração:  Salário competitivo (a combinar), compatível com a senioridade e o mercado.


Modelo de Trabalho:  Home Office


8. Como se Candidatar

Os interessados que preencham os requisitos listados devem encaminhar o currículo

atualizado e uma breve carta de apresentação destacando suas principais conquistas na

área financeira para o e-mail:  com o assunto 

\"Vaga: Gerente Financeiro -

(Seu Nome Completo)\".

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with \"agentic\" workflows, turning complex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the \"Human-in-the-Loop\" patterns for our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.


Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma , including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and \"developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI \"thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.


What We’re Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing AI Agent Builder em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Backend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the backend components of multiple services related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Scalability - all backend services that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Backend Development team is responsible for building all the API services and backend processes with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

  • Work closely with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, practical architectures.
  • Improve existing core backend services written in NodeJS
  • Implement new solutions that interact with different core services through RPC calls
  • Write complex database queries for compliance and financial purposes


Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Javascript/Nodejs.
  • Familiar with microservices architecture
  • Have actively participated in the development of a complex platform
  • Good experience in interacting with databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies
  • Good understanding of security practices


Preferred skills

  • Experience with blockchain integration
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts
  • Ruby and Rails experience
  • Other technologies of interest: Message queues (Redis), Caches and Job Queues


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Modelagem de dados

Integração de dados (ETL/ELT, APIs)

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the opportunity:

What You’ll Do Everyday:

- Design and develop the code driven interfaces between our data platform and a variety of internal and external services.

- Take projects from initial requirements gathering through to production deployment and proactive monitoring.

- Build scalable transformations in dbt.

- Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and long term maintainability.

- Leverage AI assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude) to increase development velocity and deliver high-quality solutions faster.

- Partner with Engineering, Product and Analytics teams to solve complex but interesting data challenges.

- Advanced hands-on experience with dbt (incremental models, testing and project organization).

- Active experience using AI coding tools to enhance productivity and code quality.

- Expert command of Git, CI/CD workflows and Docker/Kubernetes.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


Desired Skills - Preferred Requirements

- Knowledge of or familiarity with data design patterns like Medallion.

- Experience with Terraform/Atlantis.



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. description:

Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil.


Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level?

Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita?

O Grupo AG Tax Tech, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.

Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco.


Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões:


1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos:


Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas; Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado.


2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador:


Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção?

Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero.


3) Mentalidade \"TaxTech\"


Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário.


O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria:


•Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

•Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.

•Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).

•Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico.


Você se identifica com este perfil?


Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você.

description:

Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos.   • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.

title: Especialista de Sucesso do Cliente
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista de Sucesso do Cliente em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Todas as vagas da Arco são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência.

O Especialista de Sucesso do Cliente é o guardião estratégico do Ensino Superior após a fase de implementação. Seu foco principal é assegurar a saúde da carteira, garantindo que o valor contratado seja entregue de forma contínua para viabilizar a retenção, renovação e expansão (upsell/cross-sell) do portfólio.


Essa pessoa atua como o consultor de confiança dos mantenedores e executivos, transformando a complexidade operacional em resultados mensuráveis. O papel é fundamental para consolidar a parceria de longo prazo, agindo proativamente na mitigação de riscos de cancelamento (churn) e transformando clientes satisfeitos em promotores e fontes de novas indicações.


No dia a dia você irá:

  • Ser o ponto focal de contato entre o isaac e as faculdades, com um relacionamento próximo e consultivo com os parceiros, visando o aumento da fidelização.
  • Garantir um atendimento ativo e encantador, sempre buscando superar as expectativas dos parceiros.
  • Negociação de parcerias com instituições, conduzindo todas as etapas do processo desde o início da operação (pós-onboarding) até a renovação e retenção de contratos.
  • Atuação em estratégias de up-selling para potencializar as parcerias.
  • Monitoramento da satisfação dos parceiros, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e soluções personalizadas.
  • Ter senso de urgência para priorizar atividades;
  • Garantir que a voz dos nossos clientes está chegando nas demais áreas da empresa de maneira clara e estruturada;
  • Ter disposição para encarar viagens e visitas presenciais aos nossos clientes;


Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência trabalhando com Customer Success, na gestão de Grandes Contas B2B, com capacidade de construir relacionamento de confiança com clientes;
  • Perfil analítico, com domínio de Google Sheets / Excel
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplas atividades em paralelo;
  • Capacidade de conduzir negociações de maneira transparente, firme e idônea;
  • Excelente comunicação, com habilidade de adaptação para diferentes níveis (operacional - executivo)
  • Alta capacidade de priorização de atividades baseado em dados e urgência;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM como Zendesk e SalesForce;


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com operações complexas (educação, fintech, SaaS ou meios de pagamento);
  • Experiência com integrações (ERP, APIs, etc.);
  • Experiência em projetos de melhoria de processos e jornada do cliente

+ Parcerias para MBA e Pós Graduação

title: Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto
description:

➡️Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto ⬅️ (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes)

(local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro)

✅ O que você vai fazer?

- Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura).

- Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite).

- Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas.

- Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade.

- Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação).

- Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas.

- Reunião com clientes e stakeholders.

✅ Qual a formação?

- Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica.

- Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados.

✅O que precisa ter para participar?

- Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal).

- Perfil proativo.

- Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação.

- Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia).

- Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas.

✅ Indispensável:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura

- Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato.

title: Sr. Data Engineer (Snowflake)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Data Engineer (Snowflake) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong execution partner to their Snowflake Architect to own medium–high complexity engineering tasks end-to-end and accelerate delivery across multiple workstreams. This is a senior, independent contributor, not a junior or support role.


What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain data pipelines in Snowflake
  • Develop ELT transformations (dbt / advanced SQL)
  • Implement architectural patterns defined by Snowflake Architect (dynamic tables, external tables, etc.)
  • Design scalable, analytics-ready data models
  • Optimize performance and cost in Snowflake
  • Embed data quality, testing, and documentation
  • Collaborate directly with the architect and a broader D&A team


What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of data engineering experience
  • 5+ years of deep hands-on expertise in Snowflake (performance tuning, modeling, pipelines), Advanced SQL, and dbt or similar ELT frameworks
  • Strong experience with AWS services (S3, IAM, integrations with Snowflake), and Python, including Snowflake Python (Snowpark preferred)
  • Proven ability to deliver complex pipelines independently, and translate high-level architecture into production solutions
  • High ownership, low ego
  • Strong communicator in a remote setup
  • Able to push back and think critically (not just execute tickets)


Preferred:

  • A solid understanding of Snowflake Dynamic Tables and modern features, Iceberg/lakehouse patterns, and Airflow or orchestration tools
  • Exposure to Sigma / Tableau


Work Schedule: Overlap with Hawaii Standard Time preferred


Duration: 6 to 12 months with possible extension


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead data-driven projects and deliver impactful analytics solutions for high-profile clients.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.



*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

title: Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

➡️Líder Técnico de equipe de Sensoriamento Remonto ⬅️ (experiência de 3 com gestão de equipes)

(local: Brasil/ home office – atuar na área de Inteligência Agro)

✅ O que você vai fazer?

- Gestão técnica das frentes de sensoriamento remoto aplicadas à agricultura (monitoramento de safra, fenologia, detecção de mudança, uso e cobertura).

- Definir critérios e padrões técnicos (metodologias, janelas temporais, máscaras, regras de evidência, validações e critérios de aceite).

- Treinamento de equipes, revisões técnicas, suporte em decisões e resolução de problemas.

- Desenvolver e manter automações e pipelines em Python para ganho de eficiência, escala e reusabilidade.

- Validar a consistência e qualidade dos outputs (rastreabilidade, replicabilidade, evidências e documentação).

- Priorizar e gerenciar backlog/demandas (Jira), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas.

- Reunião com clientes e stakeholders.

✅ Qual a formação?

- Graduação concluída em Engenharia Agronômica/Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal, Engenharia Ambiental, Geografia, e Engenharia Cartográfica.

- Desejável Mestrado em Sensoriamento Remoto ou Geotecnologias ou Ciência de Dados.

✅O que precisa ter para participar?

- Forte vivência com agricultura (dinâmica de safra, sazonalidade, interpretação temporal).

- Perfil proativo.

- Sensoriamento remoto aplicado à agricultura: séries temporais, índices espectrais (NDVI/ EVI/ NDWI/ NDMI etc.), interpretação, classificação e validação.

- Python para automação e análise. Como também Google Earth Engine (GEE) e ML aplicado (classificação, detecção de anomalias, avaliação de acurácia).

- Organização/reprodutibilidade: documentação de critérios, evidências, versionamento de entregas.

✅ Indispensável:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos na liderança de equipes de sensoriamento remoto, para atuação com agricultura

- Disponibilidade para atuação de segunda à sexta em horário comercial, atuação exclusiva neste contrato.

Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Structural Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Structural Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vacancy: Structural Engineer


Do you want to be part of a globally operating team of innovators? Do you also think bigger than big? And, do you have what it takes to make an impact? Then we might be looking for you. Find out more about our vacancy for a Structural Engineer at Huisman - Navegantes/SC.


About the position of Structural Engineer


What to expect of the Structural Engineer position within Huisman?


Expect a challenging position in an international organisation. You will be part of a dynamic and professional company where innovation, quality, flexibility and creativity are key. In addition to our inspiring atmosphere, we offer an excellent benefits package . Personal development and training opportunities are all part of the package.


As a Structural Engineer , you will be responsible for the execution of engineering for services, mainly but not limited to Huisman products, in accordance with project requirements and Huisman standards.


As a Structural Engineer you will be responsible for:


  • Create and update engineering deliverables, e.g. design reports, structural calculations, and technical specifications for services.
  • Supporting the execution of service projects, e.g. production, commissioning and testing and field engineering.
  • Provide technical advice to internal and external clients.
  • Constantly monitor, manage and report on scope, quality, budget and lead time of the service project.
  • Provide input for continuous improvement of Huisman products, services and processes.


Wondering if you are 'equipped for impact'


You are/have:


  • Autonomy: engineering jobs at services tend to be short of nature and are resolved by independent engineers. You will work in a team, but rarely on the same job.
  • Client centricity: high focus on client satisfaction.
  • Flexibility: ability to deal with a high variety of jobs, priorities and internal clients, which is typical at services.
  • Problem analysis: collects and selects relevant information from different sources independently and of his/her own accord. Makes connections and organizes information.
  • Quality oriented: responsible for quality control and compliance of service work as well as proposals for improving internal standards.
  • Result oriented: set and achieve goals to deliver within quality, budget and on time in accordance with the agreed specification.


Some practical things we need you to have:


  • Advanced English (will be tested during the selection process).
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Knowledge of finite element analysis software, preferably Ansys (APDL and/or Workbench).
  • Knowledge of CAD software, preferably AutoCAD and Inventor.


Does this sound like you?


Apply online for the position of Structural Engineer by using the easy apply on LinkedIn. We are curious to see what kind of impact you will make.


What do we have to offer?


  • Private pension.
  • Fash - flexible benefit.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Education allowance.
  • Flexible and work from home policy.
  • Location of work: Volta Grande - Navegantes/SC.


We´re a Great Place to Work!

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.

SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Você é o ponto de contato direto entre o cliente e a Adaflow. Atende com autonomia, escuta com atenção, diagnostica com critério e resolve com precisão. Cada interação vira contexto, cada problema vira aprendizado, cada feedback vira melhoria.

Na prática, isso significa:

  • Atuar na linha de frente nos canais oficiais da Adaflow: WhatsApp, e-mail, chat na plataforma/site e no sistema de tickets, mantendo sempre o tom de voz da empresa.
  • Ler o histórico do cliente antes de atender. Contexto é o que diferencia um atendimento bom de um excelente.
  • Acompanhar cada chamado do início ao fim, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLAs.
  • Realizar follow-up ativo para confirmar a resolução dos problemas e medir a satisfação (NPS, CSAT).
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes sempre que o caso exigir um alinhamento mais próximo.
  • Conhecer profundamente o serviço prestado e o funcionamento do produto.
  • Diagnosticar problemas relatados, identificar a causa raiz e propor soluções adequadas, sem depender de roteiros engessados.
  • Prestar suporte de níveis 1 e 2, escalando casos complexos às áreas responsáveis quando necessário.
  • Orientar clientes sobre o uso correto da plataforma, de produtos, serviços e funcionalidades.
  • Sinalizar imediatamente sinais de cancelamento e de risco de churn, acionando as áreas responsáveis para ações de retenção.
  • Documentar todas as interações, soluções aplicadas e feedbacks no sistema, mantendo o histórico do cliente sempre atualizado e útil.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a base de conhecimento (FAQ, artigos de ajuda, scripts de atendimento), transformando aprendizados do dia a dia em material reaproveitável pelo time.
  • Identificar padrões recorrentes de problemas e abrir tickets estruturados para os times de produto, engenharia, operações ou tecnologia, com contexto suficiente para acelerar a solução.
  • Coletar, consolidar e traduzir o feedback dos clientes em aprendizado real para o produto e os processos. Não é só registrar: é interpretar, priorizar e comunicar com contexto para quem decide.
  • Mapear padrões, identificar pontos de atrito e propor melhorias na experiência ponta a ponta é parte central do trabalho, não um extra.
  • Acompanhar indicadores como tempo de resposta e de adoção, usando os dados para tomar decisões, propor mudanças e comunicar o status de forma proativa.
  • Antecipar problemas antes que o cliente precise abrir um chamado. Atendimento de verdade é o que evita o próximo ticket.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Experiência prática em atendimento ou no sucesso do cliente, especialmente em tecnologia, contabilidade, SaaS ou Fintech.
  • Noções sobre rotinas financeiras, contábeis e/ou fiscais: você não precisa ser contador(a), mas precisa entender o contexto do cliente.
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal excelente: clara, direta e empática.
  • Visão analítica: volume de chamados, tempo de resposta e CSAT fazem parte do seu dia a dia.
  • Autonomia real para atuar em ambiente remoto e dinâmico. Você organiza o próprio trabalho.
  • Repertório de ferramentas: Cloud Humans, Intercom, Take Blip, Zendesk, Zenvia, Salesforce, HubSpot ou similares. 
  • Inteligência emocional para lidar com clientes insatisfeitos.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é alto volume de chamados e prioridade que muda. 
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita: somos uma empresa global.
  • Formação em contabilidade ou estudantes de ciências contábeis.
  • Experiência em documentação de processos/Help Center.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e métricas de CS: Notion, Looker Studio, planilhas avançadas.
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e produto: você busca entender como funciona o que está atendendo.


NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO

Se você precisa de um script para tomar uma decisão, de alguém te dizendo o que fazer a cada passo, ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, há muitas empresas por aí que vão te receber bem. Essa não é uma delas.


Mas se você quer elevar o atendimento de uma empresa que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, aprender rápido, evoluir com quem coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!

The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

Essential

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to lead and coordinate impactful and B2B social media campaigns for a global organization.

Fazer parte das nossas equipes é também uma oportunidade única de viver e trabalhar com pessoas de todas as origens, nos lugares mais “instagramáveis” do mundo.

  • Forte capacidade analítica e habilidade para leitura de indicadores financeiros e de negócio;
  • Histórico consistente de superação de metas e gestão de carteira com visão de expansão;
  • Organização de pipeline e disciplina de forecast;
  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e postura consultiva.


SERÁ CONSIDERADO COMO UM DIFERENCIAL:

  • MBA ou Pós-Graduação voltado a área de Negócios;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema TOTVS / ERPs;
  • Pacote Office avançado (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • CNH válida;
  • Desejável possuir veículo próprio.
